All elements align with normal AUR packaging practices. While the source uses an untagged Git URL without a pinned commit hash, using a tag (`#tag=v0.1.0`) provides reasonable assurance of reproducibility unless the upstream tag is mutable or compromised. This constitutes a minor hygiene consideration but does not rise to the level of a supply-chain attack.
</details>
